from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType, DoubleType, TimestampType
from pyspark.sql.functions import current_timestamp, input_file_name

# Caminho origem e destino
path_raw_vh = 'abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/vehicle/1. RAW'
path_bronze_vh = 'abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/vehicle/2. BRONZE'

# Criar df da origem
schema_raw_vh = (
    StructType([
    StructField('sensor_type', StringType(), True),
    StructField('vehicle_id', StringType(), True), 
    StructField('speed', DoubleType(), True), 
    StructField('fuel_level', DoubleType(), True), 
    StructField('latitude', DoubleType(), True), 
    StructField('longitude', DoubleType(), True), 
    StructField('timestamp', TimestampType(), True)
    ])
)

df_raw_vh = (
    spark.read
    .format("parquet")
    .schema(schema_raw_vh)
    .load(path_raw_vh)
)

# Criar df para o destino com 2 colunas de controle
df_bronze_vh =(
    df_raw_vh
    .withColumn("data_ingestao",current_timestamp())
    .withColumn("arquivo_origem", input_file_name())

)
# Enviar os dados da raw para bronze usando partição e criando tabelas delta
(df_bronze_vh.write
.format("delta")
.mode("append")
.partitionBy("vehicle_id")
.save(path_bronze_vh)
